title: Protonation-number Reweighting for pH-Dependent Free Energy Calculations
description: Reference implementation of PRIME (Protonation-number Reweighting in Multi-pH Ensembles), a Python package that computes pH-dependent free energies, titration curves and stepwise pK values from the protonation numbers recorded in constant-pH simulations run at several pH values. The repository also contains electronic notebooks (Jupyter) and simulation inputs for reproducing the simulation results in the work titled above
